name: Basin Connect North
note: Operator's own site does not list towns, but Herald and News coverage (heraldandnews.com, 'Basin Transit Services announces new Basin Connect North program') and Transit App's published route (transitapp.com Basin Connect North) confirm stops at Beaver Marsh, Chemult, Crescent, Gilchrist, La Pine, and Bend, spanning North Klamath County into Deschutes County. Bend (Deschutes County) omitted from the polygon as a connection destination rather than a service zone.

name: CET Rural Dial-A-Ride
note: Seven towns/places across Central Oregon; Deschutes River Woods pilot zone added May 2026

name: CoosGO
note: 14-sq-mi service zone centered on Bandon (Bullards Beach State Park to Beach Loop Road); riders outside zone connected to fixed routes

name: SPOT Southwest
note: Service limited to South Cooper Mountain, River Terrace, Murrayhill, and Progress Ridge neighborhoods in Washington County; full county boundary shown for reference

name: Sunset Empire Transportation District Microtransit Pilot
note: Pilot program ended as of Feb 2026; service area was within Route 20 service zone covering Seaside and Cannon Beach in Clatsop County

name: TriMet NEXT
note: Service limited to South Gresham and Powell Valley neighborhoods within city limits; full city boundary shown for reference

name: UPTD Dial-A-Ride
note: Countywide service across Douglas County, but excludes ADA Paratransit service zone (open to general public with priority to seniors and people with disabilities)
